from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowData(BaseModel):
    """Net cash change reported in one company's financial filing for a fiscal year."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as stated in the filing")
    fiscal_year: int | None = Field(description="Fiscal year of the report")
    net_cash_change: float | None = Field(description="Net change in cash; positive = increase, negative = decrease")
    cash_flow_direction: str | None = Field(description="'increase' or 'decrease' as explicitly stated in the document")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Units of the amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    document_page: str | None = Field(description="Page or location reference for the data point")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_data: list[CashFlowData]
